name: textql
description: textql — execute SQL queries against structured text (CSV/TSV). No database needed, works directly on text files.

install_steps: curl -LO https://github.com/dinedal/textql/releases/download/v2.0.3/textql-linux-amd64.tar.gz && tar xzf textql-linux-amd64.tar.gz && sudo mv textql /usr/local/bin/ && rm textql-linux-amd64.tar.gz
install_guidance.note: Binary from GitHub releases or cargo/pip install.

commands.description: textql — execute SQL queries against structured text (CSV/TSV). No database needed, works directly on text files.
